remarks: The ONE you've been waiting for! Picture-perfect classic Colonial in the heart of one of New Canaan's CUTEST neighborhoods, steps from South School, Saxe Middle School, New Canaan High School, and the vibrant town center. Move right in and enjoy a spacious kitchen, generous living spaces, and a large, flat backyard perfect for entertaining, play, or relaxing outdoors. 4+ bedrooms, huge second-floor family room, light-filled unfinished third floor with charming dormer windows ready for expansion, and a lower level with high ceilings offering endless possibilities for future finished space. A rare opportunity to embrace the unmatched lifestyle, sense of community, and convenience that make New Canaan so special. Top-Rated Schools * Steps to Town * Expansion Potential * Flat Backyard * Coveted Location * Move-In Ready. Come see why so many families are loving New Canaan!
